policy.T1: Authoritative official system or managing authority source. May support material facts when the exact source/evidence is captured and current.
policy.T1B: Official delegated/subordinate/intermediate-body source. May support material facts within delegated scope when provenance is explicit; prefer T1 corroboration for conflicts.
policy.T2: Official public-sector secondary source. Corroboration/discovery by default; do not override T1/T1B material facts.
policy.T3: Discovery-only source such as search indexes or non-authoritative aggregators. Never authoritative for material facts.
policy.material_fact_change_rule: A semantic/hash change never auto-updates deadline, eligibility, budget, scoring, beneficiaries or other material facts. Create or maintain a resolution task until authoritative evidence is re-established.
policy.conflict_rule: T1 > T1B > T2 > T3. A lower-tier source may raise a conflict but never silently overwrite a higher-tier material fact.
policy.origin_rule: Official attachments linked by a verified T1/T1B page retain the page provenance chain and are hashed independently.
policy.republication_rule: An official OI/ADR republication of a MIPE document preserves discovery and corroboration value, but conflicts with an available T1 MIPE/MySMIS source must resolve in favor of current T1 evidence.
policy.programming_pipeline_rule: PROGRAMMING_PIPELINE, PROPOSAL, CONSULTATION and PLANNED observations are non-authorizing. They must never become OPEN_CALL or authorize a material deadline, budget, eligibility or call status without a current official call/topic identifier and authoritative call endpoint.
policy.direct_funding_gateway_rule: Official programme gateways, call indexes, programme guides and work-programme pages may support discovery and planning, but material call facts require the exact current call/topic/action evidence. Use the programme-specific dedicated adapter or structured Funding & Tenders adapter declared by the source; never treat a generic programme page, call index, guide or portal shell as call evidence.
